text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHCCAT01, Cat Front Door Knocker

Cat lovers rejoice! Now you can show your love for your furry feline friend right on your front door. The Cat Door Knocker is a stunning way to let your visitors know that you are a cat person. What better way to start your cat collection? The Cat Front Door Knocker was crafted by Michael Healy and displays the attention to detail for which his designs are known. This premium Oiled Bronze cat knocker is 6 inches tall, making it big enough to stand out even on large doors.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Cat Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 4"
  • Projection Off Door: 3-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
